title: Ironroot Necropolis — Avenue of Silent Forges
status: DRAFT authoring-only, not native simulation qualified

coordinate_contract.host_clearing: none, negative space assumes a cleared host

style_guide.geometry: Ribbed iron funerary portals, bolted sarcophagi, radial grafted metal roots and solemn grave registers
style_guide.rhythm: One vertical monument beside one low burial field; rotate radial focal points with linear rows; 18–28-cell gaps
style_guide.color: 60% basalt, slate and rusted industrial iron; 20% worn stone; 15% oxidised copper and brass; 5% gold remembrance glyphs
style_guide.lighting: No actual light, bell motion, rust shedding or hydraulic mechanisms in the dry preview
style_guide.avoid: No suspended powder, freely exposed oil in accepted maps, unsupported floating support claims, actor clearance assumptions
